description: This source file defines a static class 'TransactionContext' within the Orleans.Transactions namespace. The class manages transaction-related context information using AsyncLocal, providing methods to retrieve, set, and clear transaction info, as well as handle exceptions when transaction context is missing.

classes.name: TransactionContext
classes.description: Static class managing transaction context using AsyncLocal, providing static methods to access and modify transaction info.

methods.name: GetTransactionInfo
methods.description: Returns the current transaction info stored in the async local storage.

methods.name: CurrentTransactionId
methods.description: Property that retrieves the ID of the current transaction, throwing an exception if no transaction info is available.

methods.name: GetRequiredTransactionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction info or throws an exception if none is available.

methods.name: SetTransactionInfo
methods.description: Sets the transaction info in the async local storage.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the transaction info from the async local storage.
